## Iaculo Swarm (CR 8)

**XP** 4,800  
N Tiny animal (swarm)  
**Init** +6; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +11  


**Defense**


**AC** 21, touch 16, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural, +2 size)  
**hp** 144 (12d8+48)  
**Fort** +11, **Ref** +11, **Will** +7  
**Defensive Abilities** swarm traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft., climb 30 ft.  
**Melee** swarm (2d6)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 0 ft.  
**Special Attacks** puncture  


**Statistics**


**Str** 7, **Dex** 16, **Con** 17, **Int** 2, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 5  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +11 (+15 with grapple); **CMD** 19  
**Feats** [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Agile Maneuvers is part of Weapon Finesse.*  
**Skills** Climb +22, Perception +11, Stealth +22; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Climb, +4 Stealth  


**Special Abilities**



**Puncture (Ex)** If a creature leaves a iaculo swarm’s square, the swarm takes 1d4 points of damage to reflect the loss of its numbers as several iaculi stay stuck into the victim’s flesh. A creature riddled with iaculi takes swarm damage at the end of its turn each round and has its speed halved by the javelin snakes stabbed through its limbs. As a full round action, the creature can remove the snakes with a DC 19 Fortitude save but takes swarm damage in doing so. At least 10 points of damage from any area effect destroy all the iaculi stuck into a creature.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate forests  
**Organization** solitary or rain (1-6 swarms)  
**Treasure** none
